## Profile

Full stack Java/Angular/Spring Boot developer with experience in microservice architectures and DevOps workflows. Designs secure APIs (Spring Security, OAuth2), optimises databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB) and automates deployments (CI/CD, Docker). Cares about Clean Architecture and software quality. Uses AI-assisted development tools daily (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor).

## Experience

### Java Developer, Audaxis, Lac 1, Tunisia (August 2024 to present)
Product: SmartDigiDocs (https://www.smartdigidocs.com/), a Brussels-based cloud platform automating personalized documents for banks, insurers, HR and public agencies
- Integrated automated SAST and DAST security audits into Jenkins and Azure DevOps pipelines (DevSecOps).
- Designed a multi-tenant service architecture on OAuth2, SAML and JWT: RBAC/ABAC enforcement, consolidated audit trails, zero-trust alignment across tenant boundaries.
- Developed a module that generates SEPA payment codes.
- Built XML validation for the PEPPOL and EN 16931 standards.
- Designed a critical QR code validation module processing over 5,000 documents, interoperable with more than 100 client systems.
- Deployed services in Jenkins and orchestrated builds with Azure DevOps pipelines.
- Managed Active Directory through JNDI Realm and LDAP for authentication and access management.
- Worked with TDD and Agile sprints.
Environment: Java, Angular, OSGi, Eclipse EMF, Jenkins, Docker, Git, GitLab CI/CD, Maven

### Full Stack Java Developer, ERP Analyst, Audaxis, Lac 1, Tunisia (September 2023 to July 2024)
Products: APIZ (https://www.apiz-erp.com/), Audaxis's open-source ERP for mid-sized companies, and Compiere
- Designed and implemented new features and complex changes with Java/JEE, Spring Boot (backend) and Angular/TypeScript (frontend).
- Functional analysis, fast diagnosis and resolution of critical bugs.
- Optimised SQL on PostgreSQL and Oracle, sharply reducing response times of critical ERP modules.
- Built APIs connecting the ERP to other business applications.
- Set up automated GitLab CI/CD pipelines orchestrated with Docker and Kubernetes.
- Worked with business teams to align technical solutions with requirements.
Environment: Java, JEE, Spring Boot, Angular, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Oracle, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, GitLab CI/CD

### Full Stack Developer Intern, ISI, Ariana, Tunisia (February 2026 to June 2026)
- Designed and built Tabibi (https://tabibi.tn/), a digital health platform connecting patients and doctors, with real-time appointment booking and secure medical records.
- REST API in Java Spring Boot with JWT authentication, role-based access control and HTTPS.
- Cross-platform Flutter app for iOS and Android.
- Spring Data JPA persistence layer tuned for complex medical data under concurrent load.
- Real-time notifications for appointment reminders and booking confirmations.
Environment: Java, Spring Security, Spring Boot, TypeScript, Angular, Flutter, Dart, PostgreSQL, GitHub, Kafka

### Full Stack Developer Intern, Digital Power Consulting, Manzah 6, Tunisia (February 2023 to June 2023)
- Built Espace DPC, a full HR management application connecting employees, candidates and the company, with Angular and Spring Boot.
- Secure authentication and role-based access control; reusable UI components; Agile team.
Environment: Java, Spring Security, Spring Boot, TypeScript, Angular, MySQL, GitHub

### Full Stack Developer Intern, La Poste Tunisienne (June 2022 to August 2022)
- Built ResaPoste, an appointment booking platform for VIP clients, with Angular and Spring Boot.
- Code: https://github.com/ahmedhomrani/ResaPoste
